articles.title: Conan O'Brien Voices a Potty-Training Toy in Toy Story 5 — and an Intern Designed Him!
articles.summary: A new Toy Story 5 character named Smarty Pants is a potty-training toy that sounds drunk because his batteries are low. Conan O'Brien voices him, and a Pixar intern named Naomi drew the first sketch of his funny design.

articles.title: Miles Davis Was Born 100 Years Ago — and He Changed Music Over and Over Again!
articles.summary: Miles Davis, born on May 26, 1926, kept reinventing jazz for decades. His album Kind of Blue is the best-selling jazz album ever, and radio stations are celebrating his 100th birthday by playing his music all day.

articles.title: Saxophone Giant Sonny Rollins Has Died at 95 — But His Music Will Roar Forever
articles.summary: Sonny Rollins, one of the greatest saxophone players ever, died at his home in Woodstock, New York, at age 95. He was famous for his huge sound and for practicing on a bridge at night to find new ideas.
